# rootcoz

> Understand failing CI runs, collaborate on fixes, and create follow-up issues faster.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): Run RootCoz, sign in, and submit your first Jenkins, Prow, or JUnit XML analysis in just a few minutes.

## User Guides

- [Reviewing and Classifying Failures](review-and-classify-failures.md): Inspect grouped failures, compare AI reasoning, mark reviews complete, and override classifications or patterns when the default answer needs correction.
- [Exploring History and Reports](explore-history-and-reports.md): Search recurring failures, drill into test history, and compare team-level trends across dates, labels, metadata, and review status.
- [Use Server Chat for Cross-Job Analysis](use-server-chat-for-cross-job-analysis.md): Show administrators how to ask RootCoz questions across all jobs, choose or override the AI model, follow live replies in the web UI or CLI, abort or clear a session, and save or download HTML report artifacts from chat output.

## Recipes

- [Deploying RootCoz](deploy-rootcoz.md): Bring up RootCoz with Docker Compose for local use or Helm for Kubernetes and OpenShift when you need a shared deployment.
